verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser supports crawling and scraping capabilities (via MCP's scrape/crawl tools and extract()) and community evidence notes it offers higher concurrency than competitors, implying support for running many browser sessions/tasks in parallel. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk/batch API (e.g., submitting a list of URLs or items for parallel processing) or numeric concurrency limits, and no hands-on proof of large-scale bulk runs succeeding. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk operation API docs, concurrency limits/quotas, hands-on evidence of successful large-scale bulk runs.
